description: This Java class implements the <clear-field> element for the MiniLang language within the OFBiz framework. It provides functionality to clear a specific field in the method's environment map, identified by a flexible map accessor.

classes.name: ClearField
classes.description: Implements the <clear-field> element, allowing to clear a specific field in the environment map during method execution.

classes.name: ClearFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of ClearField for the <clear-field> element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Clears the specified field in the method's environment map by setting its value to null.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ClearField instance, showing the field being cleared.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ClearField from the given XML element and SimpleMethod.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the element, 'clear-field'.
